result.title: SAGE: Saliency-Annealed Gated Encoder for Universal Vision Recognition
result.summary: When adapting self-supervised Vision Transformers (ViTs) to dense prediction, existing methods often treat the ViT as a passive feature extractor and may underuse the rich priors encoded in its representations, including saliency, global context, and high-frequency details. We propose SAGE (Saliency-Annealed Gated Encoder), an enhanced ViT-Adapter backbone that explicitly exploits these priors through three complementary innovations: (1) a saliency-guided architecture that extracts DINO-style class-token (CLS) saliency to guide feature gating and high-frequency enhancement, together with dynamic multi-layer aggregation and a local-detail branch; (2) an annealing-based training paradigm designed to improve convergence and feature quality during early training while reducing feature drift later in training; and (3) a two-stage, quality-aware training mechanism that smoothly transitions from focal loss to Varifocal Loss (VFL) within a single training run. Across the evaluated tasks (Fig.~\ref{fig:fig_com}), SAGE achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) or competitive results on COCO (62.8 box AP and 55.3 mask AP), COCO keypoint estimation (78.5 AP), ADE20K (60.3 mIoU for semantic segmentation and 44.9 mask AP for instance segmentation), TinyImageNet classification (94.76\% Top-1 accuracy), and DIOR-R oriented object detection (78.8 AP$_{50}$). The same backbone is used across tasks, with task-specific decoders. To the best of our knowledge, SAGE is the first framework to achieve multi-task state-of-the-art results on Huawei Ascend NPUs. Code and pretrained models will be released after internal review.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SAGE，一种增强的 ViT-Adapter 骨干：用 DINO 风格的 CLS 显著性引导特征门控与高频细节增强，配合动态多层聚合、退火式训练以及 focal 到 Varifocal 的两阶段损失，在分割、检测、关键点等多项视觉识别任务上报告 SOTA 或竞争性结果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其以 CLS 显著性作为门控信号来筛选并增强特征的做法，可能为 LVR 中「视觉证据筛选」与任务必要细节在内部状态中的保留提供可核查的机制线索；但论文本身不涉及 latent reasoning 或多模态推理，迁移性未知。
